presentation.speaker: victor
presentation.title: Hale Group makes an offer
lines: Victor Hale. I read your numbers, not your pitch.
Hale Group will pay {price} for {company}: {basis}, plus {assets} in cash, stock and money owed, less {debts} you owe.

choices.label: Accept: sell {company} for {price}
choices.detail: You get {take} now and stay on as managing director. Hale Group owns the company from here: its cash stays in it, and you can't take money out.
choices.outcome: Victor: "Good. My lawyers will call yours. You keep the desk."

choices.label: Counter: ask for {counter_price}
choices.detail: {uplift} more, but only {counter_now} now. The other {counter_later} is an earn-out: paid in a year, and only if revenue stays above {floor} of today's. You stay on as managing director.
choices.outcome: Victor: "You'll get it, with conditions. Read them twice."

choices.label: Decline: stay independent
choices.detail: No sale. You keep the company, its profits and its problems. Victor says the door stays open.
choices.outcome: Victor: "Understood. If your numbers get bigger, so will mine."
